record.question: Which country starts "sin" taxes on tobacco products, energy drinks and soft drinks?
record.explanation: Answer C: UAE. The UAE government records introduction of excise tax in 2017 on goods including tobacco, carbonated drinks and energy drinks. This identifies UAE in the historical news context. Historical/source note: Sin tax is informal language; do not infer current tax rates or claim other countries never taxed those goods. Reference: https://u.ae/en/information-and-services/finance-and-investment/taxation/excise-tax. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
